aligned_accuracy.title: Aligned accuracy
aligned_accuracy.explanation: Accuracy after optimally aligning nominal predicted states to the synthetic truth.
aligned_accuracy.meaningful_when: Meaningful when ground-truth states are available.

balanced_accuracy.title: Balanced accuracy
balanced_accuracy.explanation: Average per-state recall after state alignment so rare regimes matter.
balanced_accuracy.meaningful_when: Meaningful when class imbalance matters and ground truth is available.

adjusted_rand_index.title: Adjusted Rand index
adjusted_rand_index.explanation: Partition similarity between inferred and true states, adjusted for chance.
adjusted_rand_index.meaningful_when: Meaningful when the goal is recovering the latent partition, not exact labels.

normalized_mutual_information.title: Normalized mutual information
normalized_mutual_information.explanation: Information overlap between inferred and true state partitions.
normalized_mutual_information.meaningful_when: Meaningful when comparing clustering-like state assignments.

macro_f1.title: Macro F1
macro_f1.explanation: Average F1 across aligned states so each regime contributes equally.
macro_f1.meaningful_when: Meaningful when precision and recall both matter for each regime.

boundary_precision.title: Boundary precision
boundary_precision.explanation: Share of predicted regime changes that match true change points.
boundary_precision.meaningful_when: Meaningful when timing of regime transitions matters.

boundary_recall.title: Boundary recall
boundary_recall.explanation: Share of true regime changes detected by the model.
boundary_recall.meaningful_when: Meaningful when missed transitions are costly.

boundary_f1.title: Boundary F1
boundary_f1.explanation: Harmonic mean of boundary precision and recall.
boundary_f1.meaningful_when: Meaningful when both false alarms and misses matter.

recovery_score.title: Recovery score
recovery_score.explanation: Composite mean of available truth-based recovery metrics for synthetic benchmarks.
recovery_score.meaningful_when: Meaningful only for experiments with known true states.

regime_persistence.title: Regime persistence
regime_persistence.explanation: Fraction of adjacent observations that remain in the same inferred regime.
regime_persistence.meaningful_when: Meaningful as a stability diagnostic, not as a standalone ranking target.

switching_frequency.title: Switching frequency
switching_frequency.explanation: Fraction of adjacent observations that change inferred regime.

occupancy_concentration.title: Occupancy concentration
occupancy_concentration.explanation: Herfindahl concentration of state occupancy; lower means less single-state collapse.
occupancy_concentration.meaningful_when: Meaningful for spotting degenerate models that stay in one state.

state_entropy.title: State entropy
state_entropy.explanation: Entropy of empirical state occupancy across the sample.
state_entropy.meaningful_when: Meaningful for judging regime diversity, with caution on very noisy models.

probability_entropy.title: Probability entropy
probability_entropy.explanation: Average uncertainty of filtered regime probabilities.
probability_entropy.meaningful_when: Meaningful only for models that expose probabilities.

transition_concentration.title: Transition concentration
transition_concentration.explanation: Average maximum one-step transition probability by current state.
transition_concentration.meaningful_when: Meaningful for understanding how decisive inferred transitions are.

confidence_calibration.title: Confidence calibration
confidence_calibration.explanation: Expected calibration error of top-state confidence against correctness.
confidence_calibration.meaningful_when: Meaningful only when ground truth and probabilities are both available.

fit_seconds.title: Fit seconds
fit_seconds.explanation: Observed wall-clock training time from the training diagnostics artifact.
fit_seconds.meaningful_when: Meaningful for operational cost and benchmark practicality.

prediction_coverage.title: Prediction coverage
prediction_coverage.explanation: Share of rows for which the model produced a usable state prediction.
